display_long_description:
**ROOM 17 UPDATE IS LIVE!**  Dark Trip is a gothic horror escape room where you use wicked biomachinery, strange art and your own hallucinations to solve the mystery of an eerie crime. Explore strange rooms, inspect occult locations... 

[media]

and laboratory machines, reveal hidden clues through altered visions.

Welcome to one of the most **unique** and **bizarre** VR experiences, where you take on the role of an investigator searching for a missing woman...

 **The boundaries between reality, virtuality, and hallucinations dissolve,** immersing you in a **Lovecraftian nightmare.**

The only daughter of a retired businessman vanishes without a trace. Hired to investigate the case, the player discovers a seemingly abandoned laboratory. As you explore room after room, you uncover evidence of twisted experiments, scattered notebooks, and disturbing accounts from test subjects. **The gameplay revolves around solving intricate puzzles while piecing together the unsettling truth of the past.**

[media]

Dive into a haunting world filled with **grotesque biotechnological machinery** and **the wicked remnants of dark experiments**.

[media]

**Experience mind-bending psychedelic trips** that distort perception and twist your surroundings.

[media]

The goals of Early Access are to refine the game using feedback from our community.

[media]

JOIN OUR DISCORD at http://iworlds.studio/discord

**This game is a work of fiction.** The authors encourage players to take care of their health, engage in regular physical activity, and maintain healthy relationships with their loved ones.
